photos.desc: A male hihi at Zealandia EcoSanctuary
New Zealand female Stitchbird on Wrights Hill, Wellington, adjacent to Karori Wildlife Sanctuary. Showing typical 'tail cocked' stance. (Image needs improvement)
Side profile of a male hihi in Zealandia Ecosanctuary
The sanctuary feeders were a mess of Stitchbirds today, five males bouncing around looking magnificent.
